51605470.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to 6xHis-tagged human ALKBH1 extracted from Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) assessed as dissociation constant by ITC assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal Titra: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) experiments were conducted on a MicroCal PEAQ-ITC at 20 °C. Proteins and compounds were prepared or diluted with exactly the same buffer consisting of 20 mM Bis-Tris (pH 6.5), 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM MnCl₂, and 5% glycerol. The titration was performed with an initial injection of 0.2 μL followed by 19 injections of 2.0 μL. The binding isotherms were analyzed with the MicroCal PEAQ-ITC Analysis software using one set of site binding models. In the competition ITC assay, the ALKBH1 protein was incubated with the compound for 20 min before titrating α-KG. The data were analyzed as described above.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Bioactivity of compound 29. (A, B) The dose-dependent curve of 29 in the DSF assay. (C) Bioactivity of compound 29 in the ITC assay. (D) Competition experiment with 29 and α-KG using ITC analysis.
original_paragraph.Figure 3C description: C) Bioactivity of compound 29 in the ITC assay. The graph shows the binding isotherm with the molar ratio on the x-axis and ΔH (kcal/mol) on the y-axis. The fitted curve indicates a K_D value of 0.156 ± 0.051 μM.
original_paragraph.Results section - Bioactivity Validation: The bioactivity of 29 was further validated by DSF and ITC assays (Figure 3). In the DSF assay, 29 showed a thermal shift (ΔT_m) of 8.86 °C at a concentration of 250 μM and also exhibited dose dependence (Figure 3A,B). It displayed a K_D value of 0.156 ± 0.051 μM in the ITC assay (Figure 3C). ITC assay was also performed to examine whether 29 is a competitive inhibitor of α-KG. After incubating ALKBH1 with 29 for 20 min, the binding of ALKBH1 with α-KG could not be detected, suggesting that 29 prevented the binding of α-KG to ALKBH1, implying a competitive inhibitor of α-KG (Figure 3D).

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM Bis-Tris, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM MnCl₂, 5% glycerol
